The Scarlet Witch.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick). Discounts MV 4+ instants/sorceries by her power: Mizzix's Mastery, Nibelheim Aflame, Artistic Process and the X spells cast big. A creature spell, so no Vivi trigger.

High Fae Trickster.text: Flash for everything, but a spell flashed on the opponent's turn can't use Vivi's mana (R2). A 4/2 flash flier otherwise.

Firebending Student.text: Prowess plus attack mana; the draft is not built to attack with small creatures.

Balmor, Battlemage Captain.text: Team pump per spell; the draft is not wide.

Dragonfly Swarm.text: Flier sized by the noncreature cards in the yard. With ~40 noncreature spells now in the list it grows faster than when first graded; a strong pick if a creature slot opens.

Enigma Drake.text: Flier sized by instants/sorceries in the yard; a 100-card yard fills slowly.

Arius, Flyby Trawler.text: Attack-driven seek; little discard to grow it.

Spider-Man 2099.text: Double strike and end-step burn after a non-hand cast; turn-4 lockout and a narrow trigger.

Stormchaser Mage.text: 2-drop prowess flier with haste. The cheap creature threats were cut in round 2, so this is the one to bring back if the early board feels empty.

Lilah, Undefeated Slickshot.text: Plots multicolored instants/sorceries; the draft holds only ~4 multicolored ones.

Spectacle Mage.text: Discounts MV 5+ instants/sorceries by 1; few such spells.

Gray and Adira, Forever Joined.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick). After a noncreature spell, a hasty token copy of a creature each combat: a copy of Niv-Mizzet, Visionary doubles its draws, a copy of Niv-Mizzet, Parun doubles the combo. Never copy Vivi (the copy has no counters).

Galazeth Prismari.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick). A 3/4 flier with a Treasure; artifacts tap for instant/sorcery mana. Only about four artifacts here (Primal Amulet, Resonating Lute, The Vision and Scarlet Witch, Treasures).

Rootha, Mastering the Moment.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick). An X/X hasty flier each combat after an instant/sorcery, X the biggest MV cast that turn: big after an X spell or Mizzix's Mastery.

Najal, the Storm Runner.text: Flash sorceries lose Vivi's mana (R2); attack-gated copy.

Thundering Djinn.text: Attack damage = cards drawn this turn: strong beside Niv-Mizzet, weak alone.

Neera, Wild Mage.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick). Once a turn, trades a spell you cast for a random free one — two casts, two Vivi triggers.

Vision, Spectral Synthezoid.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick), replacing Zaffai: a free noncreature spell from hand each turn, wider than Zaffai's instants/sorceries.

Academy Instructor.text: In since round 7 (owner's pick), for Fractal Anomaly: an Officer token per noncreature spell, and Instructor grows with each one.

Enraged Flamecaster.text: 2 damage per MV 4+ spell; Fiery Inscription triggers on every instant/sorcery.

Jacob Hauken, Inspector // Hauken's Insi.text: Slow card flow; the free-cast back costs 6 to reach.

Firebender Ascension.text: A cheap noncreature cast with a 2/2, but it copies ATTACK triggers the deck lacks. First in if more cheap noncreature spells are wanted from the pile.

Fevered Visions.text: A noncreature cast that draws for both players (G-42 shape: it feeds the opponent too).

Improbable Alliance.text: Needs a second draw each turn; its loot costs 6.

Don & Raph, Hard Science.text: Affinity for artifacts on attack; two artifacts in the deck.

Kylox, Visionary Inventor.text: Sacrifices your creatures to free-cast; 7 mana.

Captain Storm, Cosmium Raider.text: Artifact/Pirate payoff; the deck has neither.

Jhoira, Ageless Innovator.text: Artifact cheat; the deck has almost no artifacts.

Katara, Waterbending Master.text: Wants spells on the opponent's turn, when Vivi's mana can't be used (R2).

Heated Argument.text: Cut for Slick Sequence: 5 mana for 6 damage, where the cheaper spells grow Vivi sooner. Back in if the deck needs a big single-target answer.

Orbital Plunge.text: Cut in round 2. A 4-mana sorcery that only kills a creature (6 damage, a Lander on excess); the deck's burn now does a second thing.

Role Reversal.text: Cut for Counterspell: {U}{U}{R} sorcery-speed steal; a counterspell protects Vivi instead.

Storm of Saruman.text: Cut in round 2. A 6-mana copy engine (copies, not casts); Galvanic Iteration and Chandra cover copying now.

Lightning Strike.text: Cut for Glacial Dragonhunt: plain burn; the owner wanted spells that do a second thing.

Rapturous Moment.text: Cut for Epic Experiment: card flow plus mana, where Epic Experiment turns the same mana into several free casts.

Elemental Mascot.text: Cut for Crackle with Power: a creature (no Vivi trigger) whose impulse draw needs 5+ mana spells.

Sprite Dragon.text: Cut in round 2. A cheap creature that grows on every noncreature spell; with the curve now 3.8, the one to bring back if the early game feels empty.

Tempest Angler.text: Cut in round 2. A cheap creature that grows on every noncreature spell; a candidate if the early game needs a body.

Kaza, Roil Chaser.text: Cut in round 2. Discounts the next instant/sorcery by the Wizard count (about eight Wizards now, Vivi included).

Malcolm, the Eyes.text: Cut in round 2. A flier that investigates on your second spell each turn; a creature spell, so no Vivi trigger.

The Locust God.text: Cut in round 2. A hasty flying Insect per card drawn — strong beside Niv-Mizzet, but a 6-mana creature in a top end that is already crowded.

Wiccan, Rising Magician.text: Cut for Izzet Charm: tempo on a 5-mana creature.

Professor Zei, Anthropologist.text: Cut for Three Steps Ahead: a looter creature; the spree spell counters, copies or draws.

Tolarian Terror.text: Cut for Illuminating Lash: a body, not a spell; the yard fills slowly in 100 cards.

Victor Timely, Wily Tycoon.text: Cut for Galvanic Iteration: recasts one spell, but is a creature spell (no Vivi trigger).

Emeritus of Conflict.text: Cut for Culmination of Studies: its Bolt copy needs a 3-spell turn first.

Invasion of Kaladesh.text: Cut in round 2. The Thopter is the whole value; the Vehicle back needs artifacts.

Izzet Guildgate.text: Replaced by Steam Vents: always enters tapped.

Swiftwater Cliffs.text: Replaced by Spirebluff Canal: always enters tapped.

Stark Industries.text: Replaced by Fiery Islet: always enters tapped (1 life on entry).

Baron, Airship Kingdom.text: Replaced by Shivan Reef: always enters tapped.

Airship Engine Room.text: Replaced by Sulfur Falls: always enters tapped; its sacrifice-to-draw costs 4.

Abandon Attachments.text: Cut for Artist's Talent: a one-shot discard-1-draw-2; Artist's Talent does the same swap on every noncreature spell and grows into a cost reducer and a damage amplifier.

Wisdom of Ages.text: Cut for Mizzix's Mastery: returns the yard to hand for {U}{U}{U} 7; the Mastery casts the yard instead, each spell a Vivi trigger.

Colorstorm Stallion.text: Cut for Archmage of Runes: a creature (no Vivi trigger) whose copy needs 5+ mana spells; Archmage discounts and draws on every instant/sorcery.

Vibrant Outburst.text: Cut in round 4. Plain 3 damage plus a tap; the deck has since moved to burn that does a second thing.

Tome Blast.text: Cut for Glen Elendra's Answer: 2 damage twice; the deck wanted an uncounterable shield for its big turn more.

Abstract Paintmage.text: Cut for Primal Amulet: a once-a-turn ritual on a creature; the Amulet discounts every instant/sorcery and flips into a copy-land.

Guttersnipe.text: 2 damage to the opponent on every instant/sorcery = two Niv-Mizzet draws. Needs a cut: Ral, Crackling Wit (grows on spells but slow) or Melek; Paradigm Shifter was dismissed by the owner and Saheeli is gone.

Improvisation Capstone.text: Down from ★★: Sunbird's Invocation and Surtland Elementalist now fill the free-cast role at the top end, and the deck already holds 12 cards at MV 6+. Proposed cut if kept: Wanda's Vision or Culmination of Studies.

Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong.text: Down from ★★: a 6-drop in a top end of 12, and its natural cut (Charred Foyer) is a card the owner keeps.

Sunbird's Invocation.text: In since round 7, for Thousand-Year Storm: every spell from hand cascades into a free one — a cast, so Vivi triggers.

Shark Typhoon.text: In since round 5 (owner's pick), replacing Saheeli: an X/X flying Shark per noncreature spell, X its mana value; cycles for a card when you need one.

Jin-Gitaxias, Progress Tyrant.text: Cut for Ajani Unrelenting (owner's pick): gives up the once-a-turn counter on the opponent's spells and the copy for Ajani's Wizard tokens and refill.

Kraum, Violent Cacophony.text: In since round 5, replacing Twinned Vision: a flier that draws and grows on your second spell every turn.

Swan Song.text: Cut by the owner: it gives the opponent a 2/2 flier, against the owner's rule on removal that helps the opponent.

Memory Lapse.text: Cut in round 5 for Gray and Adira. A soft counter; Wizard's Retort is the better cheap counter if one comes back.

Asgardian Inspiration.text: Cut for Rootha: a 1-mana impulse that costs {2} each time it returns — slow.

Expansion // Explosion.text: Cut for The Scarlet Witch by the owner's choice. Still the best late sink here: X to the face draws X with Niv-Mizzet, Visionary. First back in if a spell slot opens.

Zaffai and the Tempests.text: Cut for Vision, Spectral Synthezoid: the same free cast from hand each turn, limited to instants and sorceries.

Firemind's Research.text: Cut in round 5 for Galazeth Prismari. Charge counters into cards or 5 damage — slow beside the deck's draw engines.

Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar.text: Cut for Shark Typhoon: 1/1 hasty flying Thopters per noncreature spell, where Shark makes an X/X.

Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir.text: Up from ◇: with Jin-Gitaxias gone, the deck's protection reads 2; opponents acting only at sorcery speed shields a Vivi turn. {U}{U}{U}.

Twinned Vision.text: Cut for Kraum: three cards once against Kraum's draw on every two-spell turn.

Wizard's Staff.text: In since round 6. Equip Wizard {1}: on Vivi her trigger fires twice per noncreature spell (two counters, two damage, two Niv-Mizzet, Visionary draws); on either Niv it doubles that Niv's trigger.

Harmonic Prodigy.text: In since round 6. Every other Wizard's triggers fire twice — Vivi, both Nivs, Archmage, Tellah, Gandalf. Stacks with Wizard's Staff.

Human Torch, Johnny Storm.text: In since round 6. With another Hero out (The Scarlet Witch, Vision and Scarlet Witch, Vision, Spectral Synthezoid), each draw pings the opponent and Niv-Mizzet, Visionary draws per ping: a second two-card kill.

Otawara, Soaring City.text: In since round 6, for an Island: a blue source that channels into bounce, cheaper per legendary creature.

Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance.text: In since round 6, for a Mountain: a red source that channels into two hasty 1/1s.

Flux Channeler.text: Up from ★★ (round 7): Pensive Professor is in now, so every proliferate also draws a card (Pensive draws when it gets a counter, and Harmonic Prodigy doubles both). Still grows Vivi, Ajani and Chandra loyalty, and Primal Amulet's charge. Proposed cut: Tempest Trapper.

Wizard Class.text: In since round 7, for Indris: level 3 puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature per card drawn — on Vivi, Niv-Mizzet's draws become mana.

Swiftfoot Boots.text: Hexproof for Vivi for {1} — the deck's protection reads 2-3. Owned. Cut idea: Charred Foyer.

Naru Meha, Master Wizard.text: Up a notch: other Wizards get +1/+1, which now includes Ajani's Cadet tokens and Vivi (one more mana).

Irencrag Pyromancer.text: Owner's add. A Wizard (Harmonic Prodigy doubles it) that deals 3 on your second draw each turn. Suggested cut: Slick Sequence (2 damage once).

Roaming Throne.text: Name Wizard: a third trigger doubler beside Harmonic Prodigy and Wizard's Staff. Not marked; a cut would be needed.

Volt Charge.text: Up from ★: its proliferate now also draws through Pensive Professor. Instant 3 damage. Proposed cut: Illuminating Lash.

Lwaxana Troi, Charming Guest.text: Benched by the owner. {2},{T}, stay tapped: one creature's triggers fire twice; behind Wizard's Staff and Harmonic Prodigy.

Hall of Storm Giants.text: A blue land that becomes a 7/7 ward 3; enters tapped once you have two other lands. For an Island.

Ral, Storm Conduit.text: Cut for Wizard's Staff (owner's mark): pings on every cast or copy, but the Staff doubles Vivi's own ping and draws.

Expressive Iteration.text: Cut for Harmonic Prodigy (owner's mark): a cheap impulse spell; one of the 1–2 mana noncreature spells that grow Vivi early.

Prismari Charm.text: Cut for Human Torch (owner's mark): a flexible 2-mana charm; its two 1-damage pings drew two with Niv-Mizzet.

Prismari, the Inspiration.text: Cut for Surtland Elementalist (owner's pick): a 7-drop whose storm copies are not casts, so they never grew Vivi.

Thousand-Year Storm.text: Cut for Sunbird's Invocation: same 6 mana, but its copies are not casts; Sunbird's free spells are.

Indris, the Hydrostatic Surge.text: Cut for Wizard Class: draw-per-instant/sorcery for 6, which Archmage of Runes does for 5.

Fractal Anomaly.text: Cut for Academy Instructor (owner's pick): a 1-mana token sized by draws; Instructor makes a token on every noncreature spell.

Stormcatch Mentor.text: Cut in round 7 for Pensive Professor. With 20 cards at MV 2 or less, the first card back if the early game feels thin.
